title: Artificial Neural Networks
lead: Covers: why a straight line is not enough, the neuron (aggregation and activation) and its biological parallel, building a squiggle with hidden nodes, activation functions (linear, sigmoid, tanh, ReLU, SoftPlus), how a network learns (forward pass, loss, backpropagation, gradient descent, epochs), AND vs XOR and linear separability, and hidden layers and the multi-layer perceptron. No prior lecture attendance needed.
